method: Actual native AppKit app operation through CUA accessibility reads and screenshots after all four exports completed.
observations: Final signed app launched at Museum Campus with all eight cards, transport, location menu and map attribution visible.
HUD reports 27,112,132 triangles including traffic and 5.06 GB Metal allocations in this window; the separate 640x400 self-test reports 26,950,320 static triangles.
Key 3 selected and held the corrected Shedd camera. Day and night screenshots show the low glazed pavilion and west portico without the former tall fallback blocks.
Key 5 and Space started the original dome program. Stars, aurora, planet and live timeline appeared correctly.
Space paused at normalized timeline 0.2382394891203148 (00:42 / 03:00). A later accessibility read retained that exact value while accumulated samples grew from 68 to 3,628.
N restored daylight, key 1 selected the opening flight and I resumed the 1x Museum Campus idle cycle. Final screenshot shows the complete viewport, eight cards, Day pass and Idle Pause.
Application remains running, cycling through Museum Campus.
limits: This is a final launch/control smoke check. Earlier version-scoped native evidence covers fullscreen, resizing, all five destinations and all shuttle speeds.
Sampled HUD frame rates are not a sustained performance benchmark.
